title: 野生眉的三种做法：手工、单仪器与双仪器
intro: 野生眉指强调单根线条与原生毛流的视觉表达。相同的名称背后，操作工具和线条组合可能不同。
intro_en: Hair-stroke brows use individual lines to suggest natural hair direction. The same broad name can describe different tools and combinations of strokes.

sections.title: 手工：针片走线
sections.description: 以手工针片控制走向与力度，结合原有框架补充线条。前一周可能颜色偏深，恢复与留色都应单独沟通。
sections.description_en: A manual blade is used to place strokes around the existing framework. Colour may be darker initially, so discuss healing and retention separately.

sections.title: 单仪器：按毛质选工具
sections.description: 按原生毛质选择电流仪或半抛机，以主线和辅线讨论轮廓与毛流。想要接近原生的眉感，可以从自己的基础出发讨论这一方案。
sections.description_en: One instrument is chosen for the existing hair texture. Main and supporting strokes refine the outline and direction. This can be discussed when the aim is subtle definition that sits close to the natural brows.

sections.title: 双仪器：结构与层次组合
sections.description: 电流仪铺绒毛线，半抛机走主线与结构线。框架、内部层次、密度与过渡一起设计，是否采用以本人基础与想要的风格为依据。
sections.description_en: Fine strokes and structural strokes are placed using two instruments. The framework, internal layers, density and transitions are planned together. The choice depends on the person’s starting point and preferences.

sections.title: 先看设计，再决定项目
sections.description: 到店设计免费，约30–45分钟。项目价格以大众点评当期门店信息为准，所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: The design consultation is free and takes about 30–45 minutes. Check the current Dianping listing for prices. All services include free touch-ups within one year.
